checks.item: Actual model comparison and RMSE/MAE trade-off
checks.evidence: Both Validation horizons have LSTM lowest all-query RMSE; F2 lowers RMSE versus corresponding Persistence while raising MAE. Report 04 states the trade-offs and includes all four physical partitions plus event/normal strata instead of only favorable scores.

Actual histories and CPU-only gate diagnostics support learned nonzero output weights and no saturation in sampled TRAIN/VALIDATION histories. Reports do not claim a unique error mechanism, guaranteed benefit from longer training or ultimate architectural ranking.

The two known late events only explain previously exposed historical problems. Both post-validation partitions are called exploratory/historically exposed, not pristine independent tests. Future command availability remains unproven. Dynamic voltage is not relabeled as SOH and no RUL task or IEEE 2014 experiment is added.

Nine PNGs each have same-stem PDF and plot_data.csv. Each PNG records 299.9994 dpi (standard 300-dpi metadata rounding); each PDF has a valid PDF header. This check verifies artifacts and resolution, not a second full visual-appearance review.

Historical nearest-history evidence path points to Phase_SCI_F2_Late_Extreme_Cause_Audit/outputs.

Report 04 now includes actual gate means/ranges and H120 F2 best/stop behavior with restrained interpretation.
Final report line endings normalized to LF only; exact semantic identity established by reconstructing all six prior byte hashes with original line-ending forms.
remaining_limitations: One seed, at most 12 epochs, unequal parameter counts and finite training support do not establish architecture optimality, statistical significance or final convergence.
A fixed 600-second lattice and 2048-origin training cap can miss or phase-lock short transients; these results do not evaluate every possible online raw-second origin.
Both post-validation periods have historical exposure. Their scores are exploratory rather than untouched-test evidence.
H30 and H120 can have different eligible/capped TRAIN origins; cross-horizon results are different tasks, not strictly paired performance-improvement evidence.
The input information set includes 29 prior raw observations for causal rolling statistics beyond the 300 model-input rows.
Past state/thermal/pressure clues and one-sample command lead do not prove that a future 30/120-second control plan was known at the origin.
Gate movement and lack of saturation show that a simple frozen/dead gate failure is absent, not that gate decisions are physically correct or causally improve errors.
Publication/commit to GitHub main and final commit SHA are outside this read-only review and remain the main agent's authorized final step.
